purpose: Evaluate whether historical weekly roster data can bound the positive-class denominator without becoming the active/inactive label authority.

candidate_source.name: nflverse weekly rosters with source-era-specific upstream lineage
candidate_source.availability: nflverse exposes weekly rosters back to 2002

2012_2015.important_builder_behavior: Before release, the generic status column is removed from the weekly Data Exchange frame and rejoined from Shield season-roster metadata. Therefore generic status is not accepted as the week-specific roster-state field for V09B; source-native week fields must be audited separately.

2016_2021.important_builder_behavior: The builder enumerates season schedule weeks and team-week pairs, scrapes each roster from NGS, then normalizes week numbering. NGS source semantics and status-value coverage must be qualified independently from the 2012-2015 Data Exchange era.

candidate_source.lineage_conclusion: The 2012-2021 release is not a single-source historical roster corpus. Qualification must be source-era-specific and may not transfer status semantics from Data Exchange to NGS or vice versa.

remaining_qualification_requirements: prove exact regular-season team-week coverage for each source era across 2012-2021
freeze source-era-specific status values that constitute the eligible game-day roster universe before label fitting
prove promoted/elevated players and transaction-edge cases are represented consistently
crosscheck the roster universe against official Game Book roster/player sections on a preregistered multi-season sample
measure player-team-week identity resolution, missing GSIS IDs, and duplicate rates separately by source era
pin SHA-256 for every historical weekly-roster artifact used in label construction
prove no generic Shield season-status field is inadvertently substituted for source-native week state
